topic: Thinking of stopping your SIP? 8 weeks of red
caption:
Eight straight weekly falls for the Nifty 50 — its longest run in 25 years. Every red Friday makes stopping a SIP feel sensible.

So here is the arithmetic, not an opinion. The same ₹10,000 instalment buys more units when prices are lower. That is simply what a fixed amount does at a lower price.

And here is what eight red weeks did not change: your goal date, your monthly surplus, or the next ten years.

For context, not comfort: the last streak this long was 2001, at nine weeks. The longest on record is ten weeks, in 1993. Both ended, and neither announced it in advance.

Source: market reports and index levels, 1–2 October 2026.
For education only. Not investment advice.
